_info.description: RAiD application configuration file for local development. The app fetches it at runtime, so no rebuild is needed when values change.
_info.usage: Deploy or mount this file outside the build for each environment. See doc/UI/raid-agency-app/DEPLOYMENT.md.

sections.required: keycloak, apiBaseUrl, environment and supportEmail are required. The app does not start without them.
sections.branding: This file has no theme, header or footer section, so the app shows its neutral RAiD look. Examples of agency branding are in app-config-examples/.

orcid.placeholder: Enter valid sandbox ORCID iD or ISNI
